wished.definition: Form of wish (participle past): To desire; to want.

wishes.definition: Form of wish (indicative present singular third-person): To desire; to want.

wishing.definition: Form of wish (gerund participle present): To desire; to want.

witch.definition: A person (now usually particularly a woman) who uses magical or similar supernatural powers to influence or predict events, particularly one with malicious motives.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withered.definition: Form of wither (participle past): To shrivel, droop or dry up, especially from lack of water.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

witness.definition: Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

wives.definition: Form of wife (plural): A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

wizard.definition: Someone, usually male, who uses (or has skill with) magic, mystic items, and magical and mystical practices.

woke.definition: Form of wake (past): (often followed by up) To stop sleeping.

women.definition: Form of woman (plural): An adult female human.

women’s.definition: Possessive case of women: belonging to some or all female humans.

wonder.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wondered.definition: Form of wonder (participle past): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wonderful.definition: Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary.

wondering.definition: Form of wonder (gerund participle present): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wont.definition: One's habitual way of doing things; custom, habit, practice.

won’t.definition: Will not (negative auxiliary); used to indicate a future non-occurring action.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

woods.definition: Form of wood (plural): The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

wool.definition: The hair of the sheep, llama and some other ruminants.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

wore.definition: Form of wear (past): To have on.

work.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

worked.definition: Form of work (participle past): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workmanship.definition: The skill of an artisan or craftsman.

works.definition: Form of work (indicative present singular third-person): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worn.definition: Form of wear (participle past): To have on.

worrying.definition: Form of worry (gerund participle present): To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

worst.definition: Superlative form of bad: most bad.

worthless.definition: Having no worth or use; without value.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wound.definition: Form of wind (participle past): To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.

wrapped.definition: Form of wrap (participle past): To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.

wrapping.definition: Form of wrap (gerund participle present): To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.

wrecked.definition: Form of wreck (participle past): To destroy violently; to cause severe damage to something, to a point where it no longer works, or is useless.

wren.definition: A female member of the Royal Navy (originally, a member of the WRNS).

wriggle.definition: To twist one's body to and fro with short, writhing motions; to squirm.

wring.definition: Often followed by out: to squeeze or twist (something moist) tightly so that liquid is forced out.

wrinkle.definition: To make wrinkles in; to cause to have wrinkles.

wrinkled.definition: Form of wrinkle (participle past): To make wrinkles in; to cause to have wrinkles.

wrist.definition: The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

writhing.definition: Form of writhe (gerund participle present): To twist, wring (something).

written.definition: Form of write (participle past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrung.definition: Form of wring (participle past): Often followed by out: to squeeze or twist (something moist) tightly so that liquid is forced out.

yawn.definition: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

year’s.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yew.definition: A species of coniferous tree, Taxus baccata, with dark-green flat needle-like leaves and seeds bearing red arils, native to western, central and southern Europe, northwest Africa, northern Iran and southwest Asia.

yew-tree.definition: To investigate historic sexual offences as part of Operation Yewtree, or otherwise reveal or allege someone (especially a celebrity active in the 1970s and 1980s) to be a paedophile or abuser.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youngest.definition: Form of young (superlative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

zaire.definition: The unit of currency of Zaire from 1967 to 1998.

zaire’s.definition: The unit of currency of Zaire from 1967 to 1998.
